deferredMinors.description: The CLI reads gate-r-archive-inventory.json with readFileSync directly. A fresh owned fixture whose inventory is a hard link (nlink=2) exits 0 and prints Gate R inventory valid; the contained reader deliberately rejects that identity. A symlink would likewise be followed by this read. The normal run-gate-r command uses readArtifact and remains protected.
deferredMinors.impact: Inconsistent physical-file admission between the two advertised fixed CLIs. Canonical inventory identity still must match the sealed projection, so this does not permit forged provenance, runtime activation, dispatch, or writes; nonblocking by actual user impact.
deferredMinors.recommendation: Use readGateRContainedFile with the fixed gateRRepositoryRoot for the inventory CLI input, and add a real CLI linked-inventory regression in an owned temporary fixture.
deferredMinors.title: Inventory-only --check bypasses the contained reader
